questions.text: How does the app decide that a line is NOT in code form? Note: `paid 450 to zomato yesterday` also looks like `<code> <amount> [note]`, so by today's rules it gives `Unknown code "paid".`
options: Code form = the first word is 1 to 3 letters and the second word is an amount; any other line goes to AI
The first word is a known code: rules; the first word is not a known code and the line has more than two words: AI; otherwise the unknown-code error
The user marks a plain-words line (for example by starting it with a character such as `?`)
A separate box or button for plain-words entries
questions.reason: The narrowed rule depends on this split. Without it, an unknown code could reach the AI, or the sample sentence would fail as an unknown code.

questions.text: The AI names a merchant. Which merchants can an AI-read entry have?
options: Only merchants in the merchant table (Zomato becomes ZMT); any other merchant is stored with no merchant, category only
Only merchants in the table; any other merchant makes the line an error
Any merchant name, stored as text
questions.reason: The merchant table and the expenses table only hold known merchant codes; storing a free merchant name would change the data design.

questions.text: Should an AI-read row be marked in the review table (for example `AI` next to it), so the user knows it was not read by the rules?
questions.reason: The review table today shows only rule results; the mark changes the screen.

questions.text: Today a save re-expands the text and refuses it if the result changed since the review (REQ-278). AI answers can differ each time. What should Save do for an AI-read line?
options: Save exactly what the review showed, without asking the AI again
Ask the AI again and refuse the save if the result differs
questions.reason: Asking again could make saves fail at random; not asking again needs an exception to the REQ-278 rule.

questions.text: How is a saved AI-read entry edited (REQ-280: the user re-types the short form)?
options: The edit box shows the entry in short code form (e.g. `ZMT 450 11/11 dinner`) and the rules apply
The edit box shows the sentence and the edit goes to AI again
AI-read entries cannot be edited, only deleted
questions.reason: The edit flow re-expands the typed text by the rules, which would fail on a sentence.

questions.text: What may be sent to the Claude API? Proposed: only the typed line, today's date and the category and merchant tables; no user id, name or other entries. Confirm or change.
questions.reason: It is the only place the user's data leaves the app.

questions.text: Is there a limit on plain-words lines per text box (they still count toward the 20 entries), or per day? If yes, what is it and what message is shown?
questions.reason: Each AI line is a paid API call and slower than the rules.

questions.text: Exact wording of the message when the AI is unavailable or its answer is not valid.
questions.reason: The feature asks for a clear message but does not give the text; the other error messages are fixed in the rules document.
